cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Prior to mixing, stir part A mechanically. When all of part B has been added to part A, mix continuously for 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved.

For the addition of quartz sand: When parts A and B have been mixed, add the quartz sand 0.1 - 0.3 mm and mix for a further 2 minutes until a uniform mix has been achieved. To ensure thorough mixing pour materials into another container and mix again to achieve a consistent mix. Over mixing must be avoided to minimise air entrainment.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing > Mixing Tools
cl.x: Sikafloor®-359 N must be thoroughly mixed using a low speed electric stirrer (300 - 400 rpm) or other suitable equipment.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 3-4: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: Prior to application, confirm substrate moisture content, relative humidity and dew point. As a seal coat, the product can be applied by squeegee and then back-rolled (crosswise) with a short-piled roller.

cl.c: Data sheet page 4: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Important Considerations
s: Freshly applied Sikafloor®-359 N must be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 24 hours.
Sikafloor®-359 N applied at different thicknesses can lead to different degrees of matt finish.

If heating is required do not use gas, oil, paraffin or other fossil fuel heaters, these produce large quantities of both CO2 and H2O water vapour, which may adversely affect the finish. For heating use only electric powered warm air blower systems.
The incorrect assessment and treatment of cracks may lead to a reduced service life and reflective cracking.
For exact colour matching, ensure Sikafloor®-359 N in each area is applied from the same control batch numbers.
